unknown_classes: these .ml-* classes are not emitted by the molecule's render (invented?): ml-size-lg, ml-size-md, ml-size-sm, ml-size-xs — style ONLY the classes the .ts emits
color_literal: these colours are hardcoded outside a token: rgba(0,0,0,0.08), rgba(0,0,0,0.1) — in a project with no theme every appearance value must be written as var(--ml-<token>, <literal>), so a theme can override it later
